## Antonio Gaido

### Tenure

[2022](/wiki/2022) – Present

### Title

Development Program Management Associate, Hot Wheels and Vehicles

**Antonio Gaido** is a Mattel employee who has worked at Mattel since 2022. He currently acts as a Development Program Management Associate for Hot Wheels and related vehicle brands. Prior to working at Mattel, he worked at LEGO as a Brick Specialist.
